page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre ("EPISTOLA."). Main text in a single column on the right side of a ruled frame, with an empty left column. Signature line "I. H." set in the text block. Catchword/signature line at the foot: "Periochæ" at right, with a gathering mark "A 4" at left.

p.i: ius & clangore ad præli-um hoc sanctum animosius excusciteris, & læta de-mum gratulatione; post o-pima quondam spolia, vi-ctoriali illo die redux excipiaris.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the text block and is not transcribed. The ruled frame and the faint ghost text are not printed text. The gathering mark "A 4" at the foot is partly faded and read with some doubt. The word "Periochæ" is the printed catchword.
